seo.title: SEO
seo.summary: Researches keywords and drafts articles. When you connect Ghost, WordPress, or Strapi, it can publish them, and it can refresh posts that are already live.

google-ads.title: Google Ads
google-ads.summary: Reviews the Google Ads account every day and lines up budget moves, winning keywords, and search terms to stop paying for. Nothing in the account changes until you turn that on.

outbound.title: Cold email
outbound.summary: Connects to Instantly, keeps a playbook for each campaign, and drafts replies or sends them for you.

analytics-dashboard.title: Analytics Dashboard
analytics-dashboard.detail: See your metrics in one place.
analytics-dashboard.summary: Build an analytics dashboard from the data in your warehouse.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.detail: Send a note when something is wrong.
feedback.summary: Asks you to send Graphed a short note when the product or the docs are wrong or missing.

post-to-video.title: Post to video
post-to-video.outcome: Turn a post into a video
post-to-video.detail: Give your social content a second life.
post-to-video.summary: Turns one X or LinkedIn post into a short motion-graphic video, timed to a music beat.

tesseract-motion.title: Tesseract motion
tesseract-motion.summary: Builds an editable motion graphic in Tesseract: type, diagrams, lower thirds, and overlays on footage.

enrich-linkedin-engagers.title: LinkedIn engagers
enrich-linkedin-engagers.detail: List the people engaging with your posts.
enrich-linkedin-engagers.summary: Pulls people who engaged with a LinkedIn profile or post, finds their emails, and verifies which ones can be delivered.

post-engagers.title: Post engagers
post-engagers.outcome: Turn a LinkedIn post into leads
post-engagers.detail: Profiles and verified emails for everyone who engaged.
post-engagers.summary: Deploys a LinkedIn lead tool for your team. Paste a post, or track a profile every day, and get everyone who reacted or commented, with their profile and a verified work email.

enrichment-tables.title: Enrichment tables
enrichment-tables.detail: Add more context to your lead lists.
enrichment-tables.summary: Deploys a spreadsheet for lead lists. Each column finds something for every row: people, work emails, phone numbers, company data, or AI research, and you export the result as CSV.

static-ads.title: Static ads
static-ads.detail: Make static creatives for your campaigns.
static-ads.summary: Reads a brand's current ads and website, then generates static Meta ads aimed at the angles those ads miss.

ugc-video.title: UGC video
ugc-video.detail: Create product videos for your campaigns.
ugc-video.summary: Turns a script into a finished vertical talking-head video ad. A cloned voice reads the script, the avatar is rendered speaking it, and missed words are fixed on your machine.

ugc-studio.title: UGC studio
ugc-studio.outcome: Make a grid of talking-head ads
ugc-studio.detail: Write scripts, pick avatars, and render them together.
ugc-studio.summary: Deploys a video studio for your team. Write scripts from your website, pick avatars, and render a grid of talking-head ads in parallel, each checked word by word against the script.

ad-spy.title: Ad spy
ad-spy.detail: See what they run and the gaps they leave.
ad-spy.summary: Deploys a competitor ad library that pulls Meta, Google and LinkedIn ads every day, plus a heat map of what your buyers say that no competitor ad says yet, with ad ideas for each gap.
